An amazing service and kind staff.
I bought a package deal for unlimited laser hair removal sessions for Brazilian area for 1 year ,7000 baht.
I have dark skin tone and they use the YAG nD pulse machine and also offer to apply numbing cream if the treatment is too painful.
They are kind and gentle and the place is beautiful, clean and very professional.
They communicate well via Facebook messenger and have a quick response time and answered all the questions I had before starting my sessions.
I had 2 so far.

The owner is lovely, the staff are polite and attentive, and the sales representative is amazing! She even provides behind-the-scenes skincare routine advice, which has significantly improved my skin's health.
